Read a setup file

Source: R/setup.R
read_setup.Rd

Reads a JSON file of write_setup() and rebuilds the setup.

Usage

read_setup(path, credentials = NULL)

Arguments

path

The path of a setup file.

credentials

A function with no arguments that returns the key of the decider. NULL (the default) reads the environment variable of the provider each time decide() sends requests: TYPESAFE_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, AZURE_FOUNDRY_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY. A decider_systemone() server then gets no key. A setup file holds no key and no credentials function.

Value

A setup, as from decision_setup(). The reference images keep the bytes of the file: they are not prepared again.

Details

read_setup() stops when version is not 1, and checks the questions and the names of the references as decision_setup() does. It does not check the input type of the model: decide() checks it before any request.

When the decider (provider, server URL, model, request format or image format), the questions, the references or the image settings of the file no longer give its calibrator_hash (for example, because an agent edited a description or the model), the calibrator was fitted for other answers. read_setup() then drops it with a warning: fit a new calibrator on answers of the new setup.

unserialize() restores the calibrator, which is an R object. As with readRDS(), read only setup files that you trust.

See also

Other setups: decision_setup(), write_setup()

Examples

refund <- question_noul("Does the message ask for a refund?")
setup <- decision_setup(decider_typesafe("jev-1.13.0"), list(refund = refund))
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".json")
write_setup(setup, path)
read_setup(path)
#> <decisions::decision_setup>
#> * Model: jev-1.13.0
#> * URL: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
#> * Questions: refund (2 answers)
#> * Reference images: 0
#> * Image settings: max_size = 768, upscale = FALSE, crop = "none"
#> * Calibrated: no
# A function can give the key, for example from another variable:
read_setup(path, credentials = \() Sys.getenv("MY_JEV_KEY"))
#> <decisions::decision_setup>
#> * Model: jev-1.13.0
#> * URL: https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone
#> * Questions: refund (2 answers)
#> * Reference images: 0
#> * Image settings: max_size = 768, upscale = FALSE, crop = "none"
#> * Calibrated: no
